_note: Minimum-order and pickup/delivery-charge rules (ruleset 2026_08_05, spec §12). Config is the single source of truth — thresholds/fees are NEVER hardcoded across components. Rule: an order whose SERVICE SUBTOTAL BEFORE DISCOUNT is at or above `free_delivery_min` gets FREE pickup & delivery; below it we ask the customer to add an item, and if they decline a single flat `delivery_fee` applies (stated up front, never disguised as a service price). Amounts are per-currency and already final/VAT-inclusive (services.money). Keyed by market so AED (UAE) and QAR (Qatar) diverge without code changes. Comparison for free delivery is >= (an order exactly at the minimum ships free). Decision 2026-08-05: AED/QAR 30 minimum, AED/QAR 10 fee (was 50/8).
